linkTitle: Open the relevant record in INDEXUS

new-task.name: New task
new-task.subject: A new task is ready
texts: A new task is ready. Review its summary and confirm acceptance in INDEXUS.
The task has been added to your work list. Before proceeding, check the instructions and the next step.
Read its instructions and context in INDEXUS.
Check the instructions and record your progress.

action-needed.name: Action required
action-needed.subject: A further step is required
texts: Your action is needed to continue the task. Review the request and confirm the next step in INDEXUS.
One of your tasks is awaiting review. Take a moment to check it and confirm how the process should continue.
Open the relevant task in INDEXUS, review the request and confirm how to proceed.
Check the instructions and available information.
Save your choice in the workflow.

completed.name: Successfully completed
completed.subject: The task is complete
completed.artworkAlt: Illustration of a successfully completed administrative task
texts: The task has been completed. Open INDEXUS and review the recorded result.
Automation has recorded completion of the scheduled step.
The result record is available in INDEXUS.
You can securely find the result and related information in INDEXUS.

deadline.name: Deadline reminder
deadline.subject: The scheduled deadline is approaching
deadline.artworkAlt: Illustration of a calendar and an administrative deadline
texts: The task deadline is approaching. Check its status and determine the next step in INDEXUS.
The scheduled deadline needs a brief review. Pay attention to the timing and the next step.
The current date and time are available in the record.
Open the task and check its status.
If further action is needed, record it in the relevant INDEXUS record.

data-change.name: Data change
data-change.subject: The INDEXUS record has been updated
texts: A data change has been recorded in INDEXUS. View the details after signing in securely; sensitive values are not sent by email.
A data change has been recorded in INDEXUS. This email does not contain specific values from before or after the change.
Review the details securely after signing in to INDEXUS. If you were not expecting this link, open the system using your saved address.

information.name: Important information
information.subject: New in INDEXUS: a clearer operations overview
texts: Explore the updated INDEXUS operations overview and find your way around day-to-day operations more quickly.
The INDEXUS operations overview now has a clearer layout. Find everyday information more quickly — without unnecessary switching.
Open the new overview and see what has changed.

check-data: Verify that the data is correct and complete. Add any missing information.
contact-verify: Contact the relevant person, verify the current status and record the result.
complete-documents: Request the missing supporting documents and attach them to the record.
response-needed: The record is awaiting a response. Review the latest communication and arrange the next step.
overdue: The deadline has been exceeded. Verify the cause and take corrective action.
urgent-review: The situation requires priority review. Record your findings and the measures taken.
handover: Add a brief context and hand the case over to the responsible team. Verify that it has been accepted.
